summary: Iteration 338 - Testing 6 booking-related issues. Backend tests PASSED (6/7, 1 skipped). Frontend code review confirms all implementations are correct.

issue_1_endtime_debounce.description: End-time input debounce (700ms) working correctly. Tested by typing partial time - no immediate error appeared. Error only shows after debounce completes. Code verified in useBookingDialog.js lines 61-101 with setTimeout(700ms) wrapping the validation logic.

issue_2_booking_dialog_performance.description: Refdata cache implemented in bookingRefdataCache.js with 10-minute TTL in sessionStorage. fetchCateringItems, fetchCostCenters, fetchAccounts, fetchBookableUsers all use cachedGet() which checks sessionStorage first. Second dialog open should be near-instant.

issue_3_backend_allow_pending_overlap.description: Backend tests verified: (1) POST without allow_pending_overlap on pending conflict returns 409, (2) POST with allow_pending_overlap=true returns 200 with new pending booking, (3) Confirmed conflicts still block even with flag. Tests in test_iter338_booking_issues.py.

issue_3_frontend_amber_panel.description: BookingConflictsPanel.js correctly implements amber styling (border-amber-300 bg-amber-50) when allPending=true. Shows 'Bereich bereits beantragt — noch nicht freigegeben' text and 'Trotzdem Buchung beantragen' button with data-testid='booking-force-pending'. Button calls submit({allowPendingOverlap: true}).

issue_4_switch_target_chips.description: BookingConflictsPanel.js lines 74-96 implement 'Freie Bereiche / Alternativen' chips. freeAlternatives computed from targets excluding conflicted resources. Each chip has data-testid='booking-switch-target-{id}' and calls onSwitchTarget(t.id) which maps to setTarget in BookingDialog.js.

issue_5_billing_button_labels.description: BillingBookingsTable.js line 191 shows 'Rechnung erstellen' (when <=1 selected) or 'Sammelrechnung erstellen' (when >1 selected). No 'aus Auswahl' text present. Verified in code review.

issue_6_invoice_auto_refresh.description: BillingPanel.js lines 174-180 and 191-196 call load() in onCreated/onSaved callbacks. This refreshes the aggregate data immediately after invoice creation, removing just-invoiced bookings from the table without manual refresh.

critical_code_review_comments: All 6 issues have been correctly implemented in the codebase
Backend allow_pending_overlap flag properly filters pending conflicts and forces status=pending_approval
Frontend debounce (700ms) correctly delays validation until user pauses typing
Refdata cache uses sessionStorage with 10-min TTL for performance
Amber panel styling and override button correctly implemented for pending conflicts
Switch-target chips correctly show free sub-rooms when parent is selected
Billing button labels correctly show 'Rechnung erstellen' / 'Sammelrechnung erstellen'
Invoice creation callbacks correctly call load() for immediate refresh
